intent: Three lighting/interior/inspectable-counter-order proposals only; no model, source story or Unity changes.

variants.title: A / 奶白暖灯
variants.details: Lighting and palette for VARIANT A: warm and inviting, two compact cream vitreous-enamel pendant lamps with dark rim, brown braided hanging cords and modest brass fittings above the counter. One small aged brass goose-neck desk lamp with cream shade illuminates the order book without obstructing it. Subtle cold blue dusk from the two transparent windows; warm amber light pools on pale counter and bottles. Existing dark wooden floor and brown beams stay. Milk-white enamel, honey-brown wood, muted bottle green, tiny brass accents. Fixture study shows a pendant, its socket/cord, and the reading lamp in detail. Main title exactly 'A / 奶白暖灯'.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a polished game environment concept board, landscape 1536x1024 proportions, for the Chinese first-person detective game Wrong Date Testimony, set in fictional Qingchuan town in January 1931.
Primary request: improve the lighting atmosphere and inspectable objects INSIDE an already existing small milk shop, with a delivery order record book prominently placed on the service counter. This is a design proposal, not a screenshot or a final game asset.
Locked architecture: ONE simple rectangular single-storey timber room, approximately 7.2m wide and 5.8m deep. Modest dark timber floor, horizontal whitewashed plank walls with irregular large black Holstein cow-pattern patches and deep brown structure. A single straight rear counter approximately 3.8m wide with pale worn wood top and brown vertical wooden front panels. Behind it is one simple wide timber shelving unit holding glass milk bottles, not many separate cabinets. One existing rectangular transparent cross-mullioned window in EACH side wall, showing real dusk outside. Entrance is at the front opposite the counter. Keep these features consistent between panels. No new doors or windows, no second storey, no additional rooms or extra staff.
Style: finely composed painterly 3D game concept art, warm tactile materials and beveled simple forms, welcoming but restrained early-twentieth-century small-town working shop, coherent with a walnut clock shop. Clear playable floor and unobstructed front aisle; not a cafe or luxury showroom. Retain cow-pattern identity, softened by warm light; not a wholesale redesign.
Composition: clean aged ivory editorial concept-sheet background and thin dark rules. Large upper-left interior three-quarter view from a visitor just inside entrance; upper-right isolated lighting fixture study; lower-left close-up of the exact same counter with open order book reachable from the visitor side, mechanical bowl scale to one side and a few milk bottles; lower-right enlarged PAPER order-view panel. Show the same light fixtures, book and counter in every relevant panel. Labels and layout must be elegantly legible. No persons.
Essential interaction: a dark green or brown cloth/leatherbound book on a modest angled wooden reading rest at the near/front edge of the counter, directly illuminated, with paper date tabs, a brass page clip and pencil. A small matching stack of delivery-order slips and a mechanical bell nearby. The book can be opened, pages turned by month/day, enlarged and read. Also show small inspectable milk bottle with paper tag and a milk churn/return crate in the interior. No suspect annotations, hidden murder clue, arrows pointing to a solution, or highlighted clock differences.
Paper close-up text must be typeset, clear Chinese, using only this demonstration content, and must visibly say '订单查看示意'. Heading '送奶记录'. Fields '日期', '送达店家', '数量', '确认'. Two sample rows '1月19日  钟表铺  2瓶  已送' and '1月20日  旅馆  3瓶  已送'. Small bottom note '示例记录 · 非正式剧情'. Navigation '上一日' and '下一日'. Month tabs '十二月' and '一月'. These are explicitly mock data, not new historical plot facts. The records must NOT include precise arrival times or say the clock is fast; do not add the existing story's E05 independent customer signatures to this counter book. No phone/computer, LED strip, fluorescent tube, modern refrigeration, cash register display, digital clock, neon, bulky UI or equipment blocking windows.
Image text: main variant title as specified; panel labels '室内氛围', '灯具', '柜台交互', '订单查看示意'. Add no other captions apart from the specified small paper content.

Lighting and palette for VARIANT A: warm and inviting, two compact cream vitreous-enamel pendant lamps with dark rim, brown braided hanging cords and modest brass fittings above the counter. One small aged brass goose-neck desk lamp with cream shade illuminates the order book without obstructing it. Subtle cold blue dusk from the two transparent windows; warm amber light pools on pale counter and bottles. Existing dark wooden floor and brown beams stay. Milk-white enamel, honey-brown wood, muted bottle green, tiny brass accents. Fixture study shows a pendant, its socket/cord, and the reading lamp in detail. Main title exactly 'A / 奶白暖灯'.

variants.title: B / 墨绿工坊
variants.details: Lighting and palette for VARIANT B: a practical, characterful milk dispatch workshop with one elegant wide deep forest-green enamel pendant with rolled cream underside, nickel stem and cloth cord above the counter; a green glass shaded brass reading lamp lights the front-edge order book, plus a small shielded frosted-glass wall sconce on a structural post beside the shelf. Muted dark green and warm oak on the existing furnishings, black-white wooden walls retained, amber light with cooler blue-grey dusk at the side windows. Emphasize neatly sorted slip tray and paper date dividers so the order book is the natural point of attention. No militaristic or industrial warehouse look. Fixture study includes the green pendant and green glass desk lamp. Main title exactly 'B / 墨绿工坊'.

variants.title: C / 铜灯暮色
variants.details: Lighting and palette for VARIANT C: quieter, intimate and a little atmospheric, one compact square antique brass lantern-style electric pendant with softly glowing ribbed frosted glass over the counter and two small matching brass wall sconces above the shelving, low-set so they illuminate bottles rather than the ceiling. A tiny low brass shaded reading lamp makes the order-book pages clearly readable. Controlled warm amber/copper glow, softer cool blue dusk through true side windows, shadowed corners with visible details, clear well-lit walking floor. Do NOT make the shop dark, scary, Gothic, magical, tavern-like or luxurious. Existing black-white timber siding and simple rear bottle shelving retained. Fixture study shows lantern construction and frosted-glass panels. Main title exactly 'C / 铜灯暮色'.
